about: GTA 6's launch peaked at 7.91 million concurrent livestream viewers across tracked platforms (Streams Charts: 7,915,475 PV in its Nov 19 2026 day-one recap; 7,914,273 and 'preliminary' in its Nov 18 2026 article), more than 4.5 times the previous game-launch record, Valorant's closed beta (2020, 1,737,267). Separate platform peaks: Twitch 3,313,371, YouTube 3,216,408, Kick 1,498,752 (peaks may have occurred at different times, so they do not add up to 7.91M). Twitch: the gaming category with the highest Peak Viewers in Twitch history, ahead of League of Legends (3.11M), a record among games, not all categories. Viewers, not players or sales. All read 2026-11-20. Sources in BRIEF.md.
